protocol.scope: synthetic CPU float32; d32/h4/M16; one thread; no data/GPU
protocol.control: for each enhanced mode/depth: pure same-depth global rank nearest parameter or matrix-MAC count; ties smaller rank; width unchanged
protocol.timing: diagnostics/profiler OFF; CPU synchronous perf_counter_ns; initialized AdamW; synthetic MSE
protocol.flops: 2 per dense matrix/convolution MAC; explicit separate full operator inventory, not claimed total scalar FLOPs
protocol.paired_accuracy: NOT RUN for all seeds; final checkpoint only; no test selection

objective.reduction: sum sample-wise flattened ratios per batch; epoch display divided by ntrain; no epsilon

evaluation.aggregation: sample arithmetic mean; report each local seed and mean/std; never best-test seed
evaluation.normalizer: saved train-fit numerical states; no eval refit

data.normalizer: output UnitTransformer fit train; decode before loss
